title: Shadow Replay & Divergence Explorer for Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an exploration UI and backend hooks in Console that helps operators compare live production traffic against shadowed or replayed responses during canary/A-B rollouts. The feature surfaces divergence hotspots (metric deltas by route and cohort), links from cohort diffs into traces and request samples, and a guided set of checks to decide on auto-rollback. It must support shadow traffic (mirror), live replay from stored requests, and side-by-side metric timelines for selected endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Console exposes a Shadow Replay Explorer accessible from a rollout detail page
Users can select any two cohorts (primary vs candidate or baseline vs shadow) and see per-route delta heatmap and time-aligned metric timelines
For any route with high divergence, Console provides direct links to representative traces and stored request payloads
Operators can mark divergence thresholds that feed into the rollout’s auto-rollback policy (integration testable via ENG APIs)
Explorer supports three modes: live mirror comparison (shadow), replay from request archive, and synthetic load comparison
Queries for common signals (latency P50/P95, error rate, hallucination score, token throughput) are pre-built and configurable
End-to-end tests validate that selecting a cohort pair returns consistent diffs within 2x of backend metrics and that rollback triggers are recorded in audit logs
engineering_notes: Requires new aggregation endpoint that can return cohort-by-route histograms for arbitrary time windows (ENG-78654)
Backend must join request archive indices with trace IDs for representative samples (ENG-79210)
Plan to reuse existing rollout metadata model; add 'shadow_stream' and 'replay_archive_id' fields
Performance: heatmap queries must return < 2s for 5-minute window on a 30-route deployment; otherwise add pre-aggregation job
Security: stored request payloads must be redacted per redaction policy before surfaced in UI
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Rafael), Observability (Maya), and Security (Leo). Agreed scope and minimal MVP signals: latency, 5xx rate, top-k token divergence
2026-02-25: Design critique done; moved heatmap from 'by model' to 'by route' to match operator workflows
2026-03-02: Eng spike completed (ENG-78654). Prototype endpoint returns cohort histograms for P50/P95 and error counts
2026-03-08: Security reviewed request persistence approach; decided on TTL 30 days and automated PII redaction before UI exposure
2026-03-10: Decided to add two toggles in Console: 'Enable Shadow Replay' and 'Include Request Samples' (default off for sensitive orgs)
rollout_scenarios: Canary: 5% candidate traffic mirrored + 5% routed to candidate (side-by-side)
A/B test: split 50/50 cohorts with independent metric aggregation
Shadow-only: 100% production duplicated to shadow cohort with no serving impact
Replay: replay archived requests at reduced rate to candidate model for deterministic comparison
rollback_playbook_outline: If divergence > configured threshold on both latency and hallucination for 10m: trigger canary pause
If divergence persists for 30m and error rate > 2x baseline: recommend auto-rollback
Allow manual override with audit note and rollback reason in Console
On rollback, surface a forensic bundle: cohort diffs, 20 representative traces, top changed tokens, and CPU/GPU utilization snapshot
analytics_query_examples: SELECT cohort, route, PERCENTILE(latency_ms, 50) as p50, PERCENTILE(latency_ms, 95) as p95, SUM(errors_5xx) as errs FROM rollout_metrics WHERE time >= :start AND time <= :end GROUP BY cohort, route
Example: compute divergence score = normalized_delta(p95_candidate, p95_baseline) + normalized_delta(halluc_score_candidate, halluc_score_baseline)
